statement: An active supplier answers for what the engine takes from it: an account names the requirement its spend is measured against (its budget, an active requirement), and a registry or a platform supplies at least one active component or data store; a supplier nothing is taken from is retired.
note: D-335: the supply system's suppliers had no rule (7 not judged on ff8fa43); the model reads this function's warnings as the SUP's non-conformance (JUDGED_BY_FINDINGS). Its proof is scripts/tests/test_supply.py. In warning, not blocking: the model's warnings stop no change; the deadline is PROP-supply-system's.
